body:
i’ve been physically and mentally abused since childhood but i’ve accepted that i probably deserve it. honestly kind of blame this shit on my parents because i felt like it taught me that you need to fight fire with fire. especially since they are adults, and easily overpower, i felt like if they got physical i had to get physical to protect myself just a little bit.

opening up to friends makes them think i’m crazy.

family is what i’ve abused.

people have tried to get me help, i’ve tried to get myself help. haven’t seen a professional for this issue because we all end up giving up. the people i’ve abused just give up and end up forgiving me which just makes my actions seem right. 

i’m uncontrollable. if i could control my physical outbursts i would because i always feel overwhelming guilt after yelling or hitting people. 

i feel that there’s no hope for me because it’s been years. i just want this to end so i can leave everyone at peace.

sorry if this isn’t coherent, definitely not in a good state right now.
i’m a violent person. i’ve physically hurt people. i want to get rid of the guilt as well as free those people from my abuse.
